items.defectStatement: The handler passes raw request guests to sendAddGuestsEmails instead of the filtered guests actually added. Existing attendees included in a successful request consequently receive AttendeeScheduledEmail instead of AttendeeAddGuestsEmail.
obligations: Classify only the newly added, filtered guests as new email recipients.
Preserve the full event attendee list so existing attendees still receive add-guests notifications.
items.notes: A rejected blacklisted address receives no email unless it already appears among event attendees. uniqueGuests excludes existing attendees and blacklisted addresses but does not deduplicate repeated request entries.

items.defectStatement: EventManager uses the requesting user's credentials, so an authorized non-organizer can cause calendar references without credentialId to be skipped or updated through the wrong account. A propagated calendar-update rejection also prevents notification emails after attendees have already been persisted.
obligations: Use the booking organizer's credentials for calendar updates, including references without credentialId.
Preserve the update call with the reconstructed event and existing booking references.
Allow notification processing to continue if calendar synchronization throws.
Never fall back to the requesting user's credentials when the organizer is unavailable.
items.notes: References with credentialId can fetch credentials directly, so failure is not universal. Reuse getUsersCredentials with booking.user: raw booking.user.credentials lacks the nested user.email required by CredentialPayload.

items.defectStatement: The reconstructed CalendarEvent omits booking.iCalUID, causing generated ICS attachments to fall back to booking.uid. When those identifiers differ, recipients receive an invitation with a different event identity instead of an update to the original invitation.
obligations: Carry the persisted booking.iCalUID into the event used for calendar synchronization and emails.
Preserve booking.uid as the application booking identifier and fallback when iCalUID is absent.
items.notes: Add iCalUID alongside uid; do not replace uid with the persisted calendar identifier. The existing ICS generator handles null or empty iCalUID.
